Cornwallis Park

Annapolis County, Nova Scotia

Illustrative concept plan
PROJECT OVERVIEW

A long view of the land and its potential.

Positioned between Digby and Annapolis Royal, Cornwallis Park is presented as a 240-acre land parcel with potential for phased residential, commercial and complementary uses.

Illustrative concept only. The official Cornwallis Park Secondary Planning Strategy is effective March 27, 2025 and was amended June 8, 2026. Parcel-specific zoning, ownership, the address, PID, acreage, access and all proposed uses require direct confirmation before publication or development decisions.

Concept location121 Normandy Road, Cornwallis Park
Illustrative PID05268909
Land area240 acres
RegionAnnapolis County
SettingMostly level with treed sections
AccessExisting road access indicated
FocusLand & mixed-use
VISUAL RECORD

See the project.

Images are identified as construction photography or concept/rendering material.

THE DEVELOPMENT VISION

Looking beyond the site.

The earlier concept plan identifies 121 Normandy Road, Cornwallis Park, PID 05268909, and illustrates multi-unit residential, townhomes, a commercial plaza, a warehouse facility, park space and trails. The surrounding strategy describes mostly level land with treed sections and existing road access. The address, parcel identifier, land area, access and every proposed use require current title, survey and planning confirmation before they are treated as fact.

What the published material shows

  • Phased residential and townhome potential
  • Commercial plaza and essential services
  • Warehouse or light-industrial space
  • Park and trail network
  • Tourism and hospitality concepts
  • Renewable-energy potential
